sources.name: MBIE diesel importer-cost proxy (via Figure.NZ original file)
sources.commodity: Diesel importer cost: Singapore gasoil input plus quality, freight, insurance, wharfage and market adjustments
sources.unit: NZD c/L; FX USD/NZD; derived USD/L
sources.marketType: derived import-cost proxy, not MGO spot
sources.programmaticAccess: MBIE direct page and CSV returned HTTP 403 here. Legitimate Figure.NZ open original-source download succeeded without login/key.
sources.trainingSuitability: 1170 observations usable for retrospective analysis; no verified 5-year publication-vintage history for forecast training.
sources.realtimeSuitability: Weekly lag and provisional/revised values require separate stale and revision handling.
sources.note: Actual downloaded source file has 35100 records. Figure.NZ table uses CC BY 3.0 NZ; MBIE original work uses CC BY 4.0. This is a lawful redistributed open dataset, not a workaround for a paid feed. September 23 revised costs from February 27, including dates marked Final; publication paused March 18-July 1. Latest-vintage Final does not mean known at observation time.
